title: Research on the Impact of Economic Growth on Population Health in the Yangtze River Economic Belt within the Context of a Low-Carbon Economy
content: This paper establishes a double fixed effect spatial lag model to empirically analyze the panel data of 11 provinces and cities in the Yangtze River Economic Belt from 2012 to 2021 and discusses the impact of economic growth on the health level of residents in the context of low-carbon economy.
